---
title: "JJM Annex Plot Example"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    theme: flatly
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: true
  message: false
  warning: false
params:
  assessment_dir: "assessment"
  model: "h1_1.14"
  stock: 1
---

```{r}
library(jjmR)

config_dir <- file.path(params$assessment_dir, "config")
input_dir <- file.path(params$assessment_dir, "input")
output_dir <- file.path(params$assessment_dir, "results")

mod <- readJJM(
  params$model,
  path = config_dir,
  input = input_dir,
  output = output_dir
)

plot_title <- jjm_label(params$model)
```

## Input Data

```{r}
plot_metadata_overview(mod, title = plot_title)
```

```{r}
plot_catch_fleet(mod, stock = params$stock, title = plot_title)
```

```{r}
plot_effn(mod, stock = params$stock, title = plot_title)
```

## Weight At Age

```{r}
plot_wtat(extr_wtat_fsh(mod, stock = params$stock), facet_var = "fleet",
  title = plot_title)
```

```{r}
plot_wtat_cohort(extr_wtat_fsh(mod, stock = params$stock), facet_var = "fleet",
  title = plot_title)
```

## Composition Diagnostics

```{r}
age_fits <- extr_agefits_fsh(mod, stock = params$stock)
plot_comp_ridge(age_fits, x_var = "age", facet_var = "fleet",
  x_lab = "Age", title = plot_title)
```

```{r}
fleets <- unique(age_fits$fleet)
if (length(fleets) > 0 && has_comp(age_fits, "fleet", fleets[[1]])) {
  plot_comp_fits(age_fits, x_var = "age", grp_var = "fleet",
    grp_filter = fleets[[1]], x_lab = "Age",
    title = paste(fleets[[1]], plot_title, sep = " | "))
}
```

## Index Diagnostics

```{r}
plot_indices_v2(mod, stock = params$stock, title = plot_title)
```

```{r}
index_fits <- extr_indices(mod, stock = params$stock)
surveys <- unique(index_fits$survey[!is.na(index_fits$obs)])
if (length(surveys) > 0) {
  one_survey <- index_fits[index_fits$survey == surveys[[1]], ]
  plot_fit_diagnostics(one_survey,
    title = paste(surveys[[1]], plot_title, sep = " | "))
}
```

## Selectivity

```{r}
plot_sel_ridge(extr_sel_fsh(mod, stock = params$stock), facet_var = "fleet",
  title = plot_title, breaks_df = extr_sel_breaks(mod, "fsh"))
```

## Stock Status

```{r}
plot_summary_sheet(fixed_bmsy(mod), stock = params$stock, title = plot_title)
```

```{r}
plot_fished_unfished(mod, stock = params$stock, title = plot_title)
```

```{r}
plot_kobe(mod, stock = params$stock, title = plot_title)
```

```{r}
plot_sr(mod, stock = params$stock, title = plot_title)
```

## Historical Retrospective

```{r}
historic_file <- file.path(params$assessment_dir, "hist_retro",
  "SPRFMO historical retro.csv")

if (file.exists(historic_file)) {
  plot_historic_retro(historic_file, quantity = "stock",
    title = "Historical retrospective")
}
```
